sources.perPageMarkdown: Append .md to any docUrl for the page as markdown.
sources.extraction: "/openapi.json <method> <path>" lines under each "Source:" page in llms-full.txt; endpoint list only, no prose copied.

upstream.note: Contracts API endpoints from llms-full.txt. Legacy Plans (deprecated) endpoints listed in llms.txt are out of scope.

statusMeaning.op: Called live by a metro op (reads directly; writes only through preflight, confirm hash, sandbox-first apply and read-back).
statusMeaning.catalog-read: Reviewed read contract in `metro api catalog` (request shape, scope, docs link); no dedicated live command yet unless one is listed.
statusMeaning.catalog-write: Reviewed write contract in `metro api catalog`; local preview and validation only, live apply blocked unless an op covers it.
statusMeaning.not-yet: Documented by Metronome; metro has no catalog entry or op for it yet. Read the Metronome page directly.
